title: Positive product with fixed sum
statement:
Two nonnegative numbers sum to $2([$a])+4$. What is their maximum product?

[__________]{a}
hints: Write one number in terms of the other.
The product is a downward-opening quadratic.
The two numbers are equal at its vertex.
solution: $P=x(2[$a]+4-x)$ is maximized at $x=[$a]+2$. The maximum is $([$a]+2)^2$.

feedback.message: The two numbers are equal at its vertex.
